hero.subtitle: Integrate enterprise-grade link management, real-time analytics, and dynamic QR codes directly into your application. Built by developers, for developers, with sub-50ms latency.
bulletPoints: RESTful architecture with predictable resource-oriented URLs
Form-encoded requests, JSON responses, and standard HTTP verbs
SDKs available for Node.js, Python, Go, and Ruby
Rate limits up to 10,000 requests per second for enterprise

terminalSnippet:
curl -X POST https://api.dragolink.com/v1/links \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "destination": "https://example.com/very-long-url",
    "domain": "link.yourbrand.com",
    "tags": ["campaign_2024", "social"],
    "expires_at": "2024-12-31T23:59:59Z"
  }'
